title: Shanghai Bright Power Semiconductor va prendre le contrôle de Kaixinli avec un investissement de 20 millions de yuans
Shanghai Bright Power Semiconductor Co., Ltd. acquired 14.01% stake in Shanghai Kaixinli Microelectronics Co., Ltd. from Xu Tonggen for CNY 2.6 million.
Shanghai Kaixinli Microelectronics Co., Ltd. announced that it expects to receive CNY 20 million in funding from Shanghai Bright Power Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
Shanghai Bright Power Semiconductor investiert in den Börsengang von CanSemi in Shenzhen
